``` { .yaml linenums="1" }
endpoints:
  - name: gateway
    group: network
    url: "icmp://192.168.1.1"
    interval: 60s
    ui:
      resolve-successful-conditions: true
    conditions:
      - "[CONNECTED] == true"

  - name: adguard1
    group: network
    url: "192.168.1.5"
    interval: 60s
    dns:
      query-name: "mydomain.com"
      query-type: "A"
    ui:
      resolve-successful-conditions: true
    conditions:
      - "[DNS_RCODE] == NOERROR"

  - name: adguard2
    group: network
    url: "192.168.1.6"
    interval: 60s
    dns:
      query-name: "mydomain.com"
      query-type: "A"
    ui:
      resolve-successful-conditions: true
    conditions:
      - "[DNS_RCODE] == NOERROR"
```
